info.title: SocialRails Public API
info.description: Schedule social media posts, view analytics, generate AI content, and manage integrations with the SocialRails API.

get.description: Public endpoint — no authentication required. Verify connectivity.
List posts in your workspace. Requires `read` scope.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (use 'posted' or 'published' for completed posts)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Posts on or after this date. Compared against the sort field: created_at by default, scheduled_for when sort=scheduled_for.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Posts on or before this date. Compared against the sort field: created_at by default, scheduled_for when sort=scheduled_for.

post.description: Create a new post. Requires `write` scope. Platform settings are automatically loaded from your workspace defaults.

warnings.description: Non-fatal advisory messages — e.g. missing optional settings that may affect publishing. The post was still created.

post.description: Create the same post for multiple platforms. Each platform counts as one post against your monthly limit. Requires `write` scope.

warnings.description: Per-platform advisory messages, prefixed with the platform name (e.g. `linkedin: no company page selected`).

get.description: Get a single post by ID. Requires `read` scope.

patch.description: Update a draft or scheduled post. Requires `write` scope. Only `draft` and `scheduled` posts can be updated.

delete.description: Delete a draft or scheduled post. Published or failed posts cannot be deleted. Requires `write` scope.

get.description: Get posting analytics for your workspace. Requires `read` scope.

parameters.name: post_id
parameters.description: Get analytics for a specific post

overview.description: Aggregate engagement metrics across all platforms. Present when engagement data is available.

last_updated.description: When engagement data was last refreshed

get.description: List connected social media accounts. Never exposes access tokens. Requires `read` scope.
Get platform capabilities, default settings, and available tools for a connected account. Requires `read` scope.

defaults.description: Workspace default settings for this platform

available_tools.description: Tools that can be triggered via POST /accounts/{id}/tools

post.description: Trigger a platform discovery tool (e.g. list Facebook pages, Pinterest boards). Requires `read` scope.

tool.description: Tool name: pages (facebook), boards (pinterest), companies (linkedin), communities (twitter)

post.description: Generate AI-powered social media content. Each request deducts 2 AI credits. Requires `ai` scope.

tone.description: Tone of voice (e.g. professional, casual, excited, humorous)

get.description: Get workspace info, plan limits, and current usage. Requires `read` scope.

post.description:
Upload a file via multipart form data. Images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP): max 10MB. Videos (MP4): max 100MB. Requires `write` scope.

For video posts, upload the video with `type: video` and a separate thumbnail with `type: thumbnail`, then pass both keys in the `media` array when creating the post.

type.description: Media type override. Use 'thumbnail' for video cover images.

post.description: Provide a publicly accessible URL and SocialRails will fetch and store the media. Images: max 10MB. Videos (MP4): max 100MB. The URL must serve the file with a correct `Content-Type` header (e.g. `video/mp4`). Requires `write` scope.

url.description: Public URL of the media to fetch

delete.description: Delete a previously uploaded media file from storage by its `media_id`. Requires `write` scope.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The `media_id` returned by the upload endpoint

post.description: Register a new webhook endpoint. Max 10 per workspace. Requires `webhooks` scope.

delete.description: Remove a webhook registration. Requires `webhooks` scope.

BearerAuth.description: API key from Dashboard > Settings > API. Keys start with `sr_live_`.

content.description: Post content as JSON object or string

status.description: `draft` — not yet scheduled. `scheduled` — queued for publishing. `posted` — successfully published. `failed` — publishing failed, see `error_message`.

media.description: R2 keys of attached media files

error_message.description: Reason for failure when status is `failed`

scheduled_for.description: ISO 8601 date in the future. Omit to save as draft.

media.description:
R2 keys returned by the media upload endpoint. The post type is determined automatically based on what you pass:

**Video posts:** Pass one video key + one thumbnail key (e.g. `["workspace/api-uploads/videos/x.mp4", "workspace/api-uploads/thumbnails/x.jpg"]`). The thumbnail key must be under the `/thumbnails/` path (upload with `type: thumbnail`).

**Instagram carousel:** Pass 2–10 image keys → automatically posted as a carousel.

**Facebook multi-photo:** Pass 2–10 image keys → automatically posted as a multi-photo post.

**TikTok photo post:** Pass 1–35 image keys with no video → posted as a TikTok photo/slideshow. Only JPEG and WebP are supported (not PNG or GIF).

**Stories (Instagram/Facebook):** Pass a single image or video key and set `postType: story` (Instagram) or `videoType: story` (Facebook) in `platform_settings`.

platform_settings.description: Override platform-specific settings. Defaults are loaded from your workspace dashboard settings.

thread.description: Thread content. First item = main post, rest = replies. Only supported on twitter and threads.

thread_media.description: Media keys per thread item, keyed by index (e.g. {"0": ["key1"], "2": ["key2"]})

thread_delay.description: Delay between thread items in minutes (0-60)

scheduled_for.description: Set to null to revert to draft

key.description: R2 storage key — use this in the `media` array when creating posts

secret.description: Signing secret — save this, it is only shown once

available_settings.description: Platform-specific setting fields and their descriptions

PlatformSettings.description: Platform-specific settings. Pass inside platform_settings keyed by platform name.

selectedLocation.description: Company page ID to post as

selectedPage.description: Facebook page ID to post as. **Required** — posts will fail without this. Configure a default in Dashboard > Settings or pass it here.

selectedPages.description: Multiple Facebook page IDs (posts to all of them)

videoType.description: `reel` — Facebook Reel (default). `video` — standard video post. `story` — Facebook Story (single image or video, disappears after 24h).

postType.description: `reel` — Instagram Reel (default, video). `image` — single image post; pass 2–10 image keys in `media` for a carousel. `story` — Instagram Story (single image or video, disappears after 24h).

post_mode.description: `DIRECT_POST` publishes immediately. `UPLOAD_TO_INBOX` saves to drafts for manual review.

photo_cover_index.description: For photo/slideshow posts: index of the cover image (0-based). Ignored for video posts.

has_more.description: Whether there are more items beyond the current page

documentation_url.description: Link to relevant documentation for this error

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the window resets

BadRequest.description: Bad request — missing or invalid fields

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, or expired API key

Forbidden.description: API key lacks the required scope, or plan does not include API access
